controles.affirmation: UBS chiffre a environ 37 Mds $ le capital CET1 supplementaire a detenir si la reforme suisse passe telle que proposee
controles.verbatim_source: Altogether, if the proposed changes by the Swiss Federal Council were adopted as proposed, UBS would be required to hold around USD 37bn in additional CET1 capital. (Rapport annuel 2025, Regulatory and legal developments)

controles.affirmation: Ventilation: 22 Mds $ au titre des propositions du Conseil federal (dont ~20 Mds $ filiales etrangeres) et 15 Mds $ lies au rachat de Credit Suisse
controles.verbatim_source: We currently estimate that UBS AG would be required to hold additional CET1 capital of around USD 22bn... This estimate includes around USD 20bn related to the full deduction of UBS AG's investments in foreign subsidiaries... This includes around USD 9bn to remove the regulatory concessions granted to Credit Suisse and around USD 6bn to meet the progressive add-on

controles.affirmation: Estimation ramenee de 24 Mds $ (06/06/2025) a 22 Mds $ grace au rapatriement accelere de capital ; entree en vigueur 2028 au plus tot, 65 % la premiere annee puis 5 points par an sur sept ans
controles.verbatim_source: around USD 2bn lower than the estimate of USD 24bn we published on 6 June 2025... The reduction primarily results from accelerated repatriation of capital from UBS AG subsidiaries / the amendments would enter into force in 2028, at the earliest, starting with a 65% deduction requirement in the first year and increasing to 100% by 5-percentage-point increments each year over seven years

controles.affirmation: UBS conditionne explicitement le rythme de ses rachats d'actions aux deliberations du Parlement suisse
controles.verbatim_source: The amount and pace of share repurchases will remain subject to our short-term financial performance and outlook, maintaining a CET1 capital ratio of around 14% and further visibility on the deliberations by the Swiss Parliament on the capitalization of foreign subsidiaries. (Communique T2 2026, note 3)

controles.affirmation: Provisions litiges 2 200 M$ fin 2025 contre 3 602 M$ fin 2024, dont 1 388 M$ en Non-core and Legacy ; passifs eventuels IFRS 3 de 531 M$ ; total 8 409 -> 5 035 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Provisions related to litigation, regulatory and similar matters (IAS 37...) 2,200 3,602 ; Acquisition-related contingent liabilities... 531 2,122 ; Total provisions and contingent liabilities 5,035 8,409 ; Balance at the end of the year ... 1,388 ... 2,200

controles.affirmation: Exposition financiere materielle pouvant depasser substantiellement les provisions ; Mozambique sous accord de poursuite differee avec le DOJ ; dossier fiscal francais regle en septembre 2025 pour 730 M EUR d'amende plus 105 M EUR de dommages
controles.verbatim_source: The extent of our financial exposure to these and other matters is material and could substantially exceed the level of provisions that we have established / the Deferred Prosecution Agreement Credit Suisse entered into with the US Department of Justice in 2021 to resolve its Mozambique matter / the case was resolved in September 2025 and UBS AG agreed to pay a fine of EUR 730m and EUR 105m in civil damages to the French State

controles.affirmation: 12,6 Mds $ d'economies brutes cumulees sur une ambition d'environ 13,5 Mds $ ; effectifs de 119 100 a 99 085 ETP depuis le T2 2023
controles.verbatim_source: bringing the cumulative gross cost savings since the end of 2022 to USD 12.6bn. This represents over 90% of our total gross cost savings ambition and keeps us firmly on track to achieve our USD ~13.5bn ambition by the end of 2026 ; Internal personnel (full-time equivalents) 99,085 (T2 2026) ; 119 100 au T2 2023 (serie KPI Mettrik verifiee)

controles.affirmation: Ecart publie / retraite au T2 2026 : PBT 3 594 contre 3 887 M$, RoCET1 15,4 % contre 16,4 %, coefficient 72,9 % contre 70,0 %
controles.verbatim_source: PBT of USD 3,594m included PPA effects and other integration items of USD 352m and integration-related expenses and PPA effects of USD 645m. Underlying PBT was USD 3,887m... The cost/income ratio was 72.9%, and 70.0% on an underlying basis... Return on CET1 capital was 15.4%, and 16.4% on an underlying basis.

controles.verbatim_source: Total revenues decreased by CHF 658m, or 8%, to CHF 7,583m ; Net interest income decreased by CHF 584m, or 12%, to CHF 4,403m (Rapport annuel 2025) ; Total revenues decreased by CHF 4m to CHF 1,896m (Communique T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Banque d'investissement: PBT 1 150 M$ au T2 2026, revenus retraites +31 % ; trois trimestres de pertes consecutifs en 2023 (-123, -230, -169 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: Investment Bank (IB) PBT USD 1,150m ; underlying total revenues were USD 3,701m, an increase of 31% ; serie KPI Mettrik IB_PBT_Q: Q2-2023 -123, Q3-2023 -230, Q4-2023 -169

controles.affirmation: Titre de section: la reforme bancaire suisse peut 'absorber' la moitie du capital dur du groupe
controles.verbatim_source: 37 Mds $ rapportes aux 72 464 M$ de CET1 au 30/06/2026 = 51 %. Le document precise que les mesures DTA/logiciels/PVA 'would eliminate around USD 11bn of net CET1 capital at UBS Group AG', le solde etant une exigence de detention supplementaire.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance de vocabulaire seulement : il s'agit d'une exigence de capital a DETENIR (le hook le dit correctement), dont environ 11 Mds $ seulement correspondent a une elimination effective de CET1. Le titre pourrait dire 'mobiliser' plutot que 'absorber'.
